name: iOS Application Security Testing
description: Security assessment of iOS applications. Covers IPA analysis, entitlements review, Keychain storage, App Transport Security, URL scheme handling, jailbreak detection bypass, and runtime manipulation using Frida and Objection.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to iOS security testing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands iOS application architecture and security model
evidence: Can explain iOS sandboxing, entitlements, and the app lifecycle
Understands Keychain, Data Protection API, and App Transport Security
Familiar with OWASP Mobile Top 10 as applied to iOS

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic iOS app analysis under supervision
evidence: Decrypted and extracted IPA files for analysis
Reviewed Info.plist, entitlements, and URL schemes
Tested data storage (Keychain, NSUserDefaults, filesystem) for sensitive data leaks
Work reviewed by authorized tester

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently tests iOS apps against OWASP MASTG methodology
evidence: Independently tested 5+ iOS applications
Bypasses certificate pinning using Objection or SSL Kill Switch
Tests URL scheme handlers and universal links for vulnerabilities
Evaluates Keychain access controls and data protection classes
Passed proficiency assessment on iOS security testing

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Tests complex iOS apps; bypasses advanced protections; writes Frida scripts
evidence: Bypasses jailbreak detection and anti-tampering mechanisms
Writes custom Frida scripts for Objective-C and Swift runtime hooking
Analyzes IPC mechanisms (XPC, Mach ports) for security flaws
Mentors junior testers on iOS testing methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on iOS security; discovers platform-level vulnerabilities
evidence: Published research or CVEs related to iOS application or platform security
Developed the lab's iOS testing methodology and tooling
Reverse engineers stripped and obfuscated Swift/ObjC binaries
Trains teams on advanced iOS exploitation techniques

assessment_methods.description: Complete a security assessment of a prepared iOS application covering OWASP MASTG test cases
Observe setup of jailbroken test device and dynamic analysis workflow
